description: Signs on to the FirstCore portal, opens Account Servicing » Fee Management, looks up an account by identifier, waives the assessed overdraft fee shown in the Assessed Fees grid, and returns the host reversal confirmation (fee reference, amount, confirmation number).

business_outcomes.note: Sign-on rejected — credentials invalid or expired.

escalate.reason: Operator account locked at sign-on; requires security administrator.

recoverable.note: Module still loading from the legacy host; wait for spinner to clear before proceeding.

business_outcomes.note: Host returned no account for the supplied identifier.
Account found but the Assessed Fees grid is empty — nothing to waive.
Account status CLOSED — fee waiver cannot be posted; return to caller.

recoverable.note: Legacy host busy/timeout on inquiry — re-execute the inquiry.

escalate.reason: Supervisor override modal raised in the top document during inquiry.

business_outcomes.note: Fee amount exceeds the operator's waiver authority.
Fee was already reversed previously; no new posting made.

recoverable.note: Reversal not posted because the host link was down; safe to retry only when the message explicitly says the posting was not accepted.

escalate.reason: Supervisor override / dual-authorization modal injected into the TOP document when posting the reversal.
Security verification challenge raised in the top document during the reversal post.
Host returned an indeterminate posting status — a human must confirm whether the reversal committed before any retry.

robustness_notes: Frames: hdrFrm / navFrm / wrkFrm, with the module nested at wrkFrm>modFrm. All interactive ids are ExtJS-style auto-generated (ext-genNN) and are the primary locators observed; they are stable within this build but likely to shift across vendor releases — fallbacks by visible text are advised: nav "Account Servicing" toggle (span showing +/-), nav item "·Fee Management", the account field also carries name='acctNbr' (prefer input[name='acctNbr']), the inquiry button text "Execute Inquiry", and the row action text "Waive Fee". Important behaviour learned: nav sub-items exist in the DOM but are hidden until the parent group is expanded by clicking the +/- SPAN (#ext-gen89) — clicking the group label div does NOT expand it, so the expand step must target the toggle span (or text "+ Account Servicing"'s span) and be verified before clicking Fee Management. Two distinct busy indicators share id #loading-spinner in wrkFrm and wrkFrm>modFrm ("Legacy host communication in progress..." for the inquiry, "Posting reversal to host..." for the waive); always wait for state=absent in the module frame before reading results. The Waive Fee click is an irreversible commit (posts a credit to the account) — replay must not blind-retry it; only retry when the module explicitly reports the posting was rejected/not accepted. The confirmation is rendered as a message div (#ext-gen110) in wrkFrm>modFrm; the checkpoint uses text matching plus regex extraction rather than the volatile id.
